title: EVOLVEpro improves proteins up to 100-fold with few experiments
summary: A protein language model combined with a regression model in an active-learning loop improved six proteins used in RNA production, genome editing and antibody binding, with up to 100-fold gains reported in the Science abstract. Online date taken from the November 2024 PubMed record (Europe PMC lists 24 January 2025); per-protein numbers not read.
ai_technology: EVOLVEpro (protein language model with active learning)

evidence.tested: Tested in the lab on six proteins across RNA production, genome editing and antibody binding, with up to 100-fold gains reported in the abstract.
evidence.unknown: The abstract does not state limitations; it implies the method still needs some experimental data.
evidence.ai_role: Few-shot active learning framework combining a protein language model with a regression model to choose protein variants.
